title: QML Frontiers
summary: A student research repository of Jupyter notebooks exploring Quantum Machine Learning tutorials and a Bachelor's thesis project applying quantum algorithms to problems like fraud detection, medical image classification, and noise mitigation. One notebook augments the iris dataset with synthetic samples using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata.
evidence: Project/iris_noise_techniques.ipynb:197-218 uses GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to augment_with_copula(X_scaled, y_binary)
